title: Agentic shared experience session
description: Proposed agent-neutral session-state envelope. Storage and agent adapters are not implemented.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version, independent of the future Dev Container Feature version.

id.description: Opaque, stable identifier unique within the shared store; not a filesystem path.
Identifier for the originating agent or adapter.

sessionId.description: Optional originating tool's session identifier, retained for provenance.

id.description: Stable project identifier independent of host or container checkout paths.

updatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent state update; must not precede createdAt.

state.description: JSON-compatible session checkpoint. Agent-specific payloads remain opaque in this initial contract.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced metadata for adapters; not part of the normalized core.
